name: devops-portfolio-app
description: Simple Express app for CI/CD pipeline demo

scripts.test: node -e "const http = require('http'); const req = http.get('http://localhost:3000/health', (res) => { let data = ''; res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk); res.on('end', () => { const body = JSON.parse(data); if (body.status === 'ok') { console.log('Health check passed'); process.exit(0); } else { process.exit(1); } }); }); req.on('error', () => process.exit(1));"
